Vadodara is one of Gujarat's strongest industrial cities — chemicals, petrochemicals, pharma, and heavy engineering across Nandesari, Makarpura, and the Savli belt. These sites need durable site offices, security cabins, and QC rooms built to handle a demanding industrial environment. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Vadodara in 3 to 5 days. For chemical and industrial sites we build with corrosion-resistant coatings as standard. For a porta cabin in Vadodara, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

Multi-room porta cabin blocks installed at Vadodara petrochemical and GIDC project sites.

Why Vadodara Buyers Choose SAMAN

Most porta cabin results a Vadodara buyer finds are IndiaMART and TradeIndia listing pages — directories that mix suppliers and say nothing about frame grade, corrosion protection, or electrical safety. For Vadodara's chemical and petrochemical belt, those are exactly the details that matter.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. Call us and you reach the team that builds the cabin — the same team that runs our porta cabins production line. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated — corrosion-protected for chemical-zone air
  • 50 mm PUF or cement-board panels with factory-sealed joints
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing — important on chemical sites
  • Colour-coated GI roof with drainage slope

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Vadodara: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer's cost.

Vadodara's Industries and Porta Cabin Demand

Vadodara's heavy-industry base creates specific, recurring porta cabin demand:

Nandesari GIDC (PIN 391340): One of Gujarat's major chemical industrial estates — dyes, intermediates, and bulk chemicals. Security cabins at plant gate entries and portable QC rooms are common requirements. The chemical environment makes powder-coated frames and cement-board panels the preferred specification — corrosion protection is not optional here.

Corrosion-protected porta cabins for Vadodara's Nandesari and Makarpura GIDC zones.

Makarpura GIDC (PIN 390010): Engineering, electrical equipment, and general manufacturing — including large public-sector engineering units. Plant gate security cabins, portable supervisor offices, and tool stores are the typical formats.

Savli and Manjusar industrial belt (PIN 391775): A fast-growing zone north of the city with auto, engineering, and pharma plants. Greenfield construction here generates multi-room contractor offices and labour accommodation demand.

Petrochemical and refinery corridor: Vadodara's large petrochemical complex and associated downstream units run shutdown-maintenance and expansion projects that need temporary contractor offices and safety-compliant site cabins.

Construction and infrastructure: Residential and commercial development along the Delhi-Mumbai Expressway alignment and city ring-road works generate contractor-office demand.

We dispatch from Greater Noida via the NH-48 Delhi-Mumbai corridor — bringing cabins to Vadodara in 3–5 days.

Porta Cabin Specifications

Built to handle Vadodara's industrial environment and Gujarat's hot summers.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth. For Nandesari and other chemical-zone sites we add an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before powder coat for extra corrosion resistance.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard. Cement-board panels recommended for chemical-belt sites where panels face fume exposure over long durations.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with drainage slope and internal false ceiling. Turbo ventilators available for summer heat.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB. Proper earthing is especially important on chemical and petrochemical sites.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Vadodara

  • Plant gate security cabins at Nandesari, Makarpura, and Savli GIDC entries
  • Portable QC and inspection rooms at chemical and pharma production lines
  • Multi-room contractor offices at petrochemical shutdown and expansion projects
  • Labour accommodation blocks at Savli/Manjusar greenfield construction
  • Supervisor offices and tool stores at Makarpura engineering units
  • Site-management offices at expressway and ring-road construction stretches

Plant gate security cabins for Vadodara's chemical and engineering GIDC plants.

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Epoxy primer + cement-board upgrade for chemical-zone sites (recommended for Nandesari)
  • RAL colour choice
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for summer heat
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

How to Order a Porta Cabin in Vadodara

Ordering from SAMAN is direct and four steps:

  1. Share your requirement. Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry. Tell us the size, the use (security cabin, QC room, contractor office), the site (Nandesari, Makarpura, Savli, or a petrochemical project), and whether the site is in a chemical zone needing extra corrosion protection.
  2. Get a specification and quotation. We confirm the right build for your site — for Nandesari and other chemical-belt locations this means the epoxy primer coat and cement-board panel options — and give you a firm price and production timeline.
  3. Production and dispatch. After you confirm, we manufacture at our Greater Noida factory and dispatch via the NH-48 corridor. Transit to Vadodara is 3–5 days.
  4. Site placement. The cabin is set on your RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, and the pre-wired board connected on arrival.

GST and Documentation for Vadodara Buyers

For buyers in Gujarat, porta cabins are classified under HSN 9406 (prefabricated structures) and attract 18% GST. We issue a full tax invoice from SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd against our Greater Noida GST registration (09ABBCS7101B1ZT). Transport is by road on flatbed trucks, with a lorry receipt and dispatch note provided. If your plant accounts or project office needs an e-way bill or specific delivery documentation, tell us at order stage and we will ensure the paperwork is ready before the truck departs. For industrial contractors and government projects, we can also provide our ISO certificates, NSIC registration (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT recognition (DIPP56005), PAN, and company incorporation documents for vendor empanelment.

Porta Cabin Price in Vadodara — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF vs cement-board (cement board preferred chemical zones).
  3. Corrosion spec — epoxy primer coat adds cost but suits Nandesari-type sites.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Vadodara for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Vadodara

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the NH-48 corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We provide factory-direct supply from North India to Vadodara and across Gujarat. We serve industrial buyers across the state, including our porta cabin in Surat and porta cabin in Rajkot coverage. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth, anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Vadodara warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Vadodara

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Nandesari, Makarpura, and Savli GIDC?

Yes. We deliver across Vadodara's industrial zones — Nandesari GIDC, Makarpura GIDC, and the Savli/Manjusar belt — and to construction sites across the Vadodara region. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

What corrosion protection do you provide for Vadodara's chemical GIDC sites?

For Nandesari and other chemical-belt sites we add an epoxy primer coat on external surfaces before the powder coat, and recommend cement-board panels over standard PUF. The MS frame is IS 2062 Grade A, zinc-phosphate primed in all cases. This gives better resistance to chemical-zone air over long service life.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Vadodara?

Price depends on size, panel type, corrosion spec, and fit-out level. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a petrochemical shutdown or government project in Vadodara?

Yes. We supply industrial contractors, petrochemical project managers, and government contractors. Our NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition, ISO certificates, GST registration, and incorporation documents are available for vendor empanelment. Share your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

How long does delivery from the factory to Vadodara take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the NH-48 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Get a Porta Cabin Quote for Vadodara

For a porta cabin in Vadodara delivered to your GIDC plot, petrochemical project, or construction site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for your site conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation. Explore our industrial porta cabin specification range for the full set of sizes, configurations, and build options.
